title: Optimize Quadratic Log Stream Deduplication to Linear Time
description: In the logging processing module (src/log_dedup.py), the `deduplicate_logs(entries: List[str], window_size: int) -> List[str]` function filters out duplicate log messages that appear within a sliding window of size `window_size`. The existing implementation uses a naive $O(N \times W)$ quadratic nested search that takes over 5 seconds on 10,000 entries and times out on larger streams. Optimize the algorithm to run in $O(N)$ amortized time using an efficient sliding window hash map or queue. The solution must preserve the exact sequential ordering of the original stream and process 50,000 log entries in under 0.50 seconds.
